title: Finite intersections of dense open subsets are dense
statement: Let X be a topological space [def-weil-irreducible-components] and let S be a finite set of subsets of X. If every U in S is open and dense in X, then the intersection of all members of S is dense in X. In particular, if X is nonempty, that finite intersection is nonempty.
